productObjective: Make /dashboard a focused daily decision cockpit that answers whether to bet today and what the best available opportunity is if the user reviews anyway.

dataSources.name: Today contract
dataSources.usage: Primary read-only dashboard decision data, including official pick count, freshness, canonical selectors, warnings, grounded opportunity counts and update timestamps.

dataSources.name: Dashboard canonical view model
dataSources.usage: Best available B2 opportunity source, preferring existing official picks, best value, highest ranked priced market, most likely summary, highest projected outcome and grounded opportunities.

verdictDerivation.wait: no official picks and stale freshness or games waiting for odds
verdictDerivation.review: no official picks and an existing best available opportunity is visible
verdictDerivation.pass: no official picks and no eligible supported opportunity is visible

bestOpportunitySource.officialDistinction: Official Pick and Best Available - Not Official are separate visible labels.

navigation.deferred: Full unified Opportunities shell is deferred to B4 and operations/admin separation is deferred to B8.

stateHandling.loading: Decision-shell skeleton with aria-busy and no fake recommendation.
stateHandling.noOfficialPick: Verdict is REVIEW, WAIT or PASS and Best Opportunity remains visible when existing data supports it.
stateHandling.noEligibleOpportunity: Truthful no-opportunity card with no fabricated selection.
stateHandling.stale: WAIT verdict path and visible freshness context.
stateHandling.providerUnavailable: Stored Today API state is shown without live-provider claims.
stateHandling.error: Safe degraded message and Operations link without stack traces.

presentationShells.aiConviction: B2 shell only; no numeric score or new formula.
presentationShells.actionability: B2 shell backed by verdict/freshness only.
presentationShells.officialPickReadiness: B2 shell showing Official/Not Official and blocker context only; structured gates deferred to B3.

informationGraphics: compact probability versus implied probability fields
compact edge and expected value fields

deferredWork.B3: Normalize Best Opportunity and implement structured Official Pick Readiness gates.
deferredWork.B4: Build unified Opportunities tabs and taxonomy.
deferredWork.B5: Add AI explanation, Conviction, Actionability and What Would Change My Mind presentation models.
